Diagnose camera-geometry association and common-support exclusions

Source: R/evidence-safeguards.R
aqt_geometry_bias_audit.Rd

Diagnose camera-geometry association and common-support exclusions

Usage

aqt_geometry_bias_audit(
  data,
  group_col = "recording",
  phase_col = "phase",
  speed_col = "speed",
  area_col = "bbox_area",
  x_col = NULL,
  y_col = NULL,
  confidence_col = NULL,
  reference_phase = "Before",
  n_strata = 5L,
  min_per_stratum = 10L
)

Arguments

data

Source step table.

group_col, phase_col, speed_col, area_col

Column names.

x_col, y_col, confidence_col

Optional image position and detector confidence columns for additional descriptive Spearman correlations.

reference_phase

Phase defining the reference comparison.

n_strata

Number of pooled bounding-box-area quantile strata.

min_per_stratum

Minimum observations per phase in an overlap stratum.

Value

Descriptive Spearman correlations and overlap coverage diagnostics.
